gloss: to compete with each other, to vie

definitions.explanation: To engage in competition with one another, each trying to outperform the other.

definitions.gloss: to vie, to rival each other
definitions.explanation: To strive to surpass each other in achievement or quality.

examples.japanese: {二人|ふたり}の{選手|せんしゅ}が{競|きそ}い{合|あ}っている。
examples.english: Two athletes are competing against each other.

examples.japanese: {企業|きぎょう}{同士|どうし}が{激|はげ}しく{競|きそ}い{合|あ}っている。
examples.english: Companies are fiercely competing with each other.

examples.japanese: {お互|たが}いに{競|きそ}い{合|あ}うことで{成長|せいちょう}できる。
examples.english: We can grow by competing with each other.

notes:
{競|きそ}い{合|あ}う is an intransitive verb ({自動詞|じどうし}) meaning to compete with each other.

COMPOUND STRUCTURE:
- {競|きそ}う (to compete) + {合|あ}う (each other) → to compete with each other

ASPECT (ている):
{競|きそ}い{合|あ}っている indicates an ongoing competition.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {激|はげ}しく{競|きそ}い{合|あ}う (compete fiercely)
- {互|たが}いに{競|きそ}い{合|あ}う (compete with each other)
- {切磋琢磨|せっさたくま}して{競|きそ}い{合|あ}う (compete while improving each other)

NUANCE:
Implies mutual competition where both parties are actively trying to outdo each other. Often used in positive contexts where competition leads to improvement.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {競|きそ}う: to compete (not necessarily mutual)
- {競争|きょうそう}する: to compete (more formal)

[Register: Neutral]
